title: Disconnection of the power supply - Create

storage.value:
User Story

 

As a system user

I want to be able to create Disconnection of the power supply object

So that I will be able to manage POD disconnection process in a flexible and correct way

 

Design: Disconnection_Of_The_Power_Supply (adobe.com)

Acceptance criteria:

  1. Creating a Disconnection of the power supply is possible from its listing page by clicking on a 'Plus' button

  2. Clicking on a Plus button will open Disconnection of the power supply's creation page

  3. Check system user permissions to be able to create a new Disconnection of the power supply

    1. For creating such object, user should have any of the permissions listed here:

      1. Create Disconnection of the power supply as a Draft

        1. Allows to create object only as a draft and do not start process

      2. Create Disconnection of the power supply as Execute

        1. Allows to create object and it is possible to start process for tax cancellation and generation

    2. Enable Plus button when user has one of the permissions

    3. Disabled Plus button when user does not have any of the mentioned permissions

  4. Default state of the Disconnection of the power supply object contains fields:

    1. Number

      1. Mandatory

      2. Always disabled

      3. Empty on creation page

      4. Text field

      5. After creating an object, system should display its number with the following logic:

        1. Disconnection-ID of newly created object (for example, Disconnection-56)

          1. In the given example, Disconnection is hardcoded prefix for number  and 56 is ID of an object

    2. Date

      1. Mandatory

      2. Always disabled

      3. Date picker

      4. Format: DD.MM.YYYY

      5. By default, should set current day of the creation

    3. Status

      1. Mandatory

      2. Always disabled

      3. Empty on creation page

      4. Two hardcoded values:

        1. Draft

        2. Executed

      5. System should automatically set a value according to the status of the object

        1. If it is as a draft should set Draft

        2. If it is saved and executed should be set Executed

      6. Import button

        1. Enabled for Executed objects.

        2. Disabled for Drafts.

        3. When clicking on a modal window for import should be opened with two buttons - Import and Cancel

        4. Fields in the modal window:

          1. File for import

          2. Optional

          3. Enabled if Request for disconnection is linked

          4. When file is selected and user clicks button Import the system should process the file and mark the checkbox and fill Disconnection date and Type of disconnection for all PODs in the file when marches the listed PODs

          5. Import file should contains three columns - POD identifier, Type of disconnection, Disconnection date (in format DD.MM.YYYY)

          6. User should be able to download empty template

          7. If import file format is not correct system should display error as validation error for the field

          8. When import completes successfully the modal window should be closed and all dates should be updates on the main screen

            1. if user uploads the file again, PODs checked on previous upload should stay checked.

          9. User Should be able to Check/uncheck checkboxes without uploading the file.

          10. User should be able to select dropdown values without uploading the file.

    4. Table

      1. Table should be displayed after adding Request for disconnection of a power supply object

        1. If not added, empty

      2. In the table should include information for PODs on the linked Request for disconnection of the power supply that are not disconnected, including PODs for which a completed Cancellation of the disconnection request exists on that request (such PODs must not be excluded solely because cancellation was executed).

      3. Table includes section:

        1. Checkbox for selecting PODs

        2. Searching is possible:

        3. All

        4. Customer identifier

        5. Customer number

        6. POD Number

      4. Pagination will always appear

      5. Number of records dropdown will have hardcoded values: 25, 50, 100

      6. 25 is selected by default

        1. Customer

          1. Mandatory

          2. Always disabled

          3. System should automatically display all the respective customers from the added 'Request for disconnection of the power supply' object

          4. Customer should be displayed with its identifier and name + legal form in format 5520222522 (COPANY JSC)

        2. Point of delivery

          1. Mandatory

          2. Always disabled

          3. System should display all PODs on the linked Request for disconnection of the power supply that are eligible for selection, including PODs for which a completed Cancellation of the disconnection request exists on that request; such PODs must appear again in the POD table and may be selected when the user saves (as draft or executes) a new Disconnection of the power supply linked to the same request.

          4. Checkbox should be selected by default, however, user should have possibility to manually unselect the checkboxes for the PODs

        3. Type of disconnection

          1. Mandatory for selected PODs

          2. By default, the dropdown should display the “Taxes for grid operator” that was used to calculate the fee for this POD in the “Request for disconnection”

          3. This dropdown contains the “Tax of grid operator” nomenclature. The nomenclature includes a field called “Type of Disconnection.” This is a text field, and the value from this field is displayed in the dropdown.

          4. Single select dropdown

          5. After selecting a POD, the “Type of Disconnection” dropdown becomes mandatory.

            1. If pod is not selected, this dropdown is disable.

            2. If a charge fee did not occur for a disconnection request, this field should be empty.

          6. The dropdown should display grid operator taxes with the following conditions:

            • Only nomenclatures with the same supplier type and grid operator as those selected in the request for disconnection should appear in the list.

          7. Additional case:

            1. In the disconnection of the power supply, we have two PODs, A and B.

            2. For POD A, 'Tax for the grid operator' was used with 'Default for POD with measurement type by settlement period' in the charge generation process. Type of disconnection: Test 1.

            3. For POD B, 'Tax for the grid operator' was used with 'Default for POD with measurement type SLP.' Type of disconnection: Test 2.

          8. If I select POD B in the power supply disconnection, the type of disconnection will be visible, and it will be possible to choose 'Test 1' as the disconnection type, even though this POD is based on SLP, not settlement period.
            ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

          9. Additional case 1:

          10. In the disconnection of the power supply we have two pods A and b

          11. A pod is a “SLP”

          12. B pod is “Settlement period”

          13. In the system, we have only one 'Taxes for the grid operator' nomenclature, and 'Default for POD with measurement type by settlement period' is selected.

          14. In the disconnection request, after clicking the charge fee button, a tax charge fee invoice will be generated only for PODs with a settlement period, only settlement PODs will have a type of disconnection in the disconnection object

          15. For SLP PODs taxes for grid operator will be enable after selecting checkbox

        4. Date of disconnection

          1. Mandatory for selected PODs

          2. Enabled only for selected PODs

          3. Date picker

          4. Format: DD.MM.YYYY

          5. Empty by default

        5. Express reconnection

          1. checkbox

          2. Enabled only for selected PODs

          3. Empty by default

    5. Sub-object:

      1. Request for disconnection of the power supply

        1. Mandatory

        2. Table should be displayed after adding Request for disconnection of the power supply object

        3. Only one object can be added

        4. Request for disconnection of the power supply is added manually by clicking on a Plus button

          1. When user clicks on a Plus button modal window should be opened with one single select dropdown:

            1. In the dropdown Request for disconnection of the power supply objects should be displayed with its name

            2. Deleted object should not be displayed

            3. only executed objects should be displayed

            4. It is possible to search object by its name

            5. Do not display the Request for disconnection of the power supply in the dropdown only when all PODs on that request are terminated. A request remains selectable when every POD on that request has only completed Cancellations of the disconnection request (executed cancellation must not permanently remove the request from the dropdown).

        5. It is possible one Request for disconnection of the power supply object to be added several Disconnection of the power supply objects until all the PODs are disconnected in it

        6. After adding Request for disconnection of the power supply it should be displayed with its number

        7. It is possible to go to the detail page by clicking on a label or an arrow

        8. It is possible to delete already added object by clicking on a delete icon

      2. Tasks

        1. Always disabled on creation mode

        2. Will be enable on Edit and Preview modes

        3. Tasks displaying logic / format:

          1. In the task sub-object, a maximum of 10 tasks should be displayed. If the number of tasks exceeds 10, pagination should be shown. If there are 10 or fewer tasks, pagination should not be visible.

          2. Task list logic:

            1. The tasks ordering should be descending by time creation

            2. Also the task format should be changed, we need to have the next format:

              1. Id

                1. Take from task number field - This logic is already added

              2. Display task status

                1. Task status should be taken from task object

                2. In the system we have the next task statuses:

                  1. Open

                  2. In Progress

                  3. Terminated

                  4. Overdue

                  5. Completed

              3. Date in format DD.MM.YYYY

                1. This logic is already added.

              4. Task type

                1. Task type should be taken from task type dropdown - this logic is already added

              5. Example:

                1. 841 - in progress – 26.02.2025 - YOLS-TEST

  5. Save as a draft button

    1. Enable if user has such permission

    2. Disabled if user does not have such permission

    3. Clicking on Save as a draft button will check all the validations (frontend and backend)

      1. If all the validations are successful, then system should create new disconnection of the power supply and display it in the listing page (shouldn't start process until its status is Draft)

      2. If frontend validations are not successful, system should display an error message with proper field

      3. If an error happens in backend, system should display an error message retrieved from the backend

  6. Save and Execute button

    1. Enable is user has such permission

    2. Disabled if user does not have such permission

    3. Clicking on Save and execute button will check all the validations (frontend and backend)

      1. If all the validations are successful, then system should create new disconnection of the power supply object and display it in the listing page (it is possible to start process)

      2. If frontend validations are not successful, system should display an error message with proper field

      3. If an error happens in backend, system should display an error message retrieved from the backend

    4. System should generate documents according selected templates and save them in Files

    5. After Executed PODs and relevant customer should be marked as Disconnected in DB

      1. If PODs are reconnected, such PODs and relevant customers should be unmarked as disconnected in the DB

    6. After executed system should check for each POD included in the disconnection is the Type of disconnection the same as in the Request for power supply disconnection.

      1. If type of disconnection is different the system should check is the Tax for the new Type of disconnection has different amount.

        1. If the amount is different, such tax should be cancelled and system should create a new tax with the correct amount for the respective customer

    7. After executed system should check for each POD included in the disconnection is the checkbox Express reconnection marked.

      1. For such PODs the system should create a new tax for Express reconnection according to Grid operator tax nomenclature.

    8. If in the Grid operator tax nomenclature a tax is with amount 0 such tax should not be created

    9. The user must be able to save disconnection changes when Express reconnection is selected and the tax amount is 0

    10. After executed, if new Tax is created, system should create liability for the respective customer

  7. When clicking on 'Cancel' or 'X' button warning pop-up message should appear: 'Are you sure you want to cancel?' Yes/No

    1. Yes - will close pop-up and user is returned to the listing page

    2. No - will close pop-up and user stays on the current page

    3. Warning message should be managed from the system settings

Customer Feedbacks: https://oppa-support.atlassian.net/browse/PDT-2874

https://oppa-support.atlassian.net/browse/PDT-2782
